cim: State lawmakers to host informational briefing about artificial intelligence innovation
cim_eredeti: State lawmakers to host informational briefing about artificial intelligence innovation
szoveg_eredeti:
Members of the Hawaiʻi Senate Committee on Labor and Technology and House Committee on Economic Development and Technology, will host a joint informational briefing Nov. 25 to examine the development and application of artificial intelligence, its role in government operations and emerging opportunities for workforce development.

The public is encouraged to attend the briefing from 10 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. in Conference Room 329 at the Hawai’i state Capitol, 415 S. Beretania St., in Honolulu. Those who can’t make it in-person can watch via livestream.

Click here to find the livestream link, hearing notice, agenda and additional meeting information. As is customary for informational briefings, no public testimony will be accepted.

The informational briefing will provide legislators an opportunity to gain a greater understanding about the evolving landscape of artificial intelligence and its implications for state government, cybersecurity and workforce development.

Committee members will have the opportunity to ask questions following each 15-minute presentation.
